rows.provisional_definition: A typed representation frame for a system, with named observables and admissible distinctions.
rows.type_signature: Description := (objects, observables, distinctions, admissible operations, failure tests)
rows.falsifier_or_check: No observables or distinctions are named.

rows.provisional_definition: The object or configuration being described under a selected description.
rows.falsifier_or_check: The object boundary cannot be stated.

rows.provisional_definition: A located configuration of a system within a description.
rows.type_signature: State(S,D) := admissible location/configuration of S under D

rows.provisional_definition: A named dimension of variation within a description.
rows.type_signature: Axis(D) := typed coordinate/ordering/distinction dimension in D
rows.falsifier_or_check: The axis adds no distinguishable variation.

rows.provisional_definition: A structured range of possible states or descriptions along one or more axes.
rows.type_signature: Continuum := states plus structure over axes
rows.falsifier_or_check: No ordering, adjacency, metric, topology, or transition relation is given.

rows.provisional_definition: A rule, threshold, surface, or distinction governing separation or crossing.
rows.type_signature: Boundary(C) := separation/crossing predicate or rule on a continuum
rows.falsifier_or_check: Crossing or separation criteria are absent.

rows.provisional_definition: A transformation acting on states, boundaries, axes, continua, or descriptions.
rows.type_signature: Operator := typed map with domain, codomain, preserved structure, lost structure
rows.falsifier_or_check: Domain/codomain and preservation/loss conditions are absent.

rows.provisional_definition: A condition that a description, state, or transformation must satisfy.
An incompatibility among active constraints under the current description.
rows.type_signature: Contradiction_D := finite active constraints not jointly satisfiable under D
rows.falsifier_or_check: The incompatibility can be resolved inside the current description.

rows.provisional_definition: A transformation or refinement that removes incompatibility without losing required organization.
rows.type_signature: Resolution := operator or description refinement satisfying active constraints
rows.falsifier_or_check: Neither preservation nor incompatibility removal is shown.

rows.provisional_definition: Loss of the configuration ability to maintain relevant organization under active constraints.
rows.type_signature: Collapse := failure of organization predicate under active constraints

rows.provisional_definition: Introduction of a new axis necessary to preserve or restore intelligibility under active constraints.
rows.type_signature: DimensionBirth := extension D -> D+axis such that old D fails and extended D restores target adequacy
rows.falsifier_or_check: The new axis is not necessary or improves no prediction/explanation/compression.
